ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Bandit controller for augmentation strength and loss choice
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs while a contextual bandit, updated at 5 stage points, picks the augmentation strength among 4 levels and the loss among BCE, focal and asymmetric loss from the current validation mAP and the loss of tail labels. Use 2 seeds. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static BCE with RandAugment; best static choice found by random search with 8 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; bandit with shuffled rewards.
COST: 24
PREDICTION: Final mAP gains about 0.6 points, tail-label mAP about 2 points, with faster convergence. It could fail if the bandit only rediscovers the best static pair, showing no benefit from adaptation.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Validation-driven switching of loss and augmentation on VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 60 epochs with a rule-based controller that reads validation mAP and the gap between tail-label and head-label recall at 6 stage points, then switches among BCE, focal and asymmetric loss and among 3 augmentation strengths. Use 5 seeds. Metrics: mAP, recall of the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static BCE with RandAugment; best static pair chosen by grid search over 9 combinations; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller fed random signals.
COST: 24
PREDICTION: Tail-label recall rises by about 2 points and mAP by 0.4. It could fail if VOC has too few rare labels for the controller to react to, so gains stay inside seed variance.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Learning-rate and loss co-adaptation on a small backbone
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-18 on MS-COCO for 30 epochs with a controller that reads the training loss slope and the tail-label mAP every 3 epochs, then chooses between cosine and step decay and between BCE and asymmetric loss. Use 2 seeds. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, number of loss spikes during training.
CONTROLS: Static cosine at peak rate 0.1 with BCE; static step decay with asymmetric loss; staged switching at fixed epochs; controller with its inputs shuffled.
COST: 8
PREDICTION: Loss spikes fall and mAP rises about 0.5 points. It could fail if the slope signal is too noisy at the 3 epoch granularity, leading to erratic switching.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Gradient-feedback tuning of optimizer and loss weights on VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-18 on PASCAL VOC for 30 epochs with a controller that adjusts the momentum of SGD and the positive-class weight of the loss at 6 stage points, based on validation mAP and gradient norm. Use 3 seeds. Metrics: mAP, recall of the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static SGD with BCE; SGD with a tuned class weight chosen by random search; staged schedule with fixed milestones.
COST: 8
PREDICTION: Convergence arrives about 4 epochs sooner with mAP within 0.3 of the best static run. It could fail if the gradient norm tracks the schedule and not the training state.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Reinforcement-learned joint controller for a vision transformer classifier
PROPOSAL: Train ViT-B/16 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs while a small policy network, updated by PPO, outputs the augmentation policy, optimizer learning rate multiplier and loss mixture at 8 stage points from a state of validation mAP, label co-occurrence drift and tail-label loss. Use 2 seeds. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static AdamW with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 8 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; policy given a constant state.
COST: 64
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 2 points and total mAP by 0.7. It could fail if the policy learns slowly relative to the length of one run and ends near the static baseline.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Population-based joint tuning of components on NUS-WIDE and VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on NUS-WIDE for 40 epochs, with a population of members that copy and perturb the augmentation strength, optimizer learning rate and loss weights at 5 epoch steps, and run the same recipe on PASCAL VOC with 3 seeds. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static SGD with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search; staged schedule with fixed milestones; population with members never copied.
COST: 64
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 1 point and total mAP by 0.5. It could fail if members converge to nearly identical settings, so the population adds cost without new signal.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint adaptive controller on two large benchmarks with a deep backbone
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-101 on MS-COCO and on NUS-WIDE for 40 epochs with 3 seeds. A recurrent controller reads validation mAP, per-label loss and label co-occurrence statistics at 5 stage points, and sets the augmentation strength, optimizer, learning rate multiplier and loss together. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, mAP variance among seeds.
CONTROLS: Static SGD with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; best static configuration from random search with 12 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller with component choices made independently.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Joint control beats independent control by about 0.4 mAP and tail mAP by 1 point. It could fail if interactions among components are weak, so independent tuning matches it.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint versus independent control of four components on COCO
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs with 4 seeds, using a recurrent controller that sets the augmentation strength, optimizer, learning rate multiplier and loss at 5 stage points from validation mAP and per-label loss. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, mAP variance among seeds.
CONTROLS: Static SGD with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; best static configuration from random search with 12 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; 4 controllers that each tune one component only.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Joint control beats the 4 single-component controllers by about 0.4 mAP and tail mAP by 1 point. It could fail if interactions are weak, so separate controllers match it.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Does augmentation strength need to follow the label frequency state
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs in 3 arms: fixed strong augmentation, fixed weak augmentation, and a schedule that lowers strength on tail-label images as their loss rises. Hold optimizer, learning rate schedule and asymmetric loss constant, with 1 seed. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, training loss curve.
CONTROLS: Fixed strong and fixed weak augmentation; linear decay of strength for all images; shuffled assignment of strength to images.
COST: 40
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 3 points in the adaptive arm. It could fail if the gain comes from lowered average strength and not from targeting tail images, which the shuffled arm will show.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint adjustment of learning rate and loss with a small backbone on COCO
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-18 on MS-COCO for 30 epochs in 3 arms: a static cosine schedule with BCE, a milestone schedule that switches to asymmetric loss at epoch 15, and a controller that sets both from validation mAP and tail-label loss at stage points. Use 3 seeds. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach the plateau.
CONTROLS: Static cosine with BCE; milestone schedule as described; controller with shuffled inputs; best static pair from random search.
COST: 40
PREDICTION: The controller gains about 0.5 mAP beyond the milestone arm. It could fail if the milestone switch already captures most of what the controller finds.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Statistical check of adaptive loss selection on VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 30 epochs with 8 seeds, comparing static asymmetric loss to a controller that picks between BCE, focal and asymmetric loss at 5 stage points from tail-label recall and validation mAP. Metrics: mAP, recall of the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, tested by a paired comparison on seeds.
CONTROLS: Static BCE; static focal loss; static asymmetric loss; controller with shuffled inputs; staged schedule with fixed switch points.
COST: 12
PREDICTION: The controller gains about 0.5 mAP and 2 points of tail recall. It could fail if the paired comparison shows the gain is within seed noise, which is plausible on a benchmark this small.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Learning-rate controller using validation plateaus on VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-18 on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 40 epochs with 4 seeds. A controller reads validation mAP at 2 epoch steps and chooses a cosine restart, a step drop or no change, while the loss and augmentation stay fixed at asymmetric loss and RandAugment. Metrics: mAP, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, count of loss spikes.
CONTROLS: Static cosine decay; static step decay; milestone schedule with drops at epochs 20 and 30; controller choosing at random; the best of 6 random-search trials.
COST: 12
PREDICTION: Convergence arrives about 5 epochs sooner and loss spikes fall. It could fail if plateaus on a small validation set are too noisy to act on.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint controller scaled to a large vision transformer
PROPOSAL: Train ViT-L/16 on MS-COCO for 80 epochs with 3 seeds, using a controller that reads validation mAP, tail-label loss and gradient norm at 8 stage points and sets the augmentation policy, AdamW learning rate, schedule shape and loss mixture together. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, and seed variance.
CONTROLS: Static AdamW with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 10 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller with independent component choices; controller given shuffled signals.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: Gains of about 0.8 mAP and 2 tail mAP hold at this size. It could fail if large models already tolerate static settings, so adaptation adds little for them.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adaptive control of four components on a base-sized transformer
PROPOSAL: Compare a learned controller with fixed thresholds on ViT-B/16 trained on MS-COCO for 40 epochs with 4 seeds. The learned controller is a gradient-boosted model fed with validation mAP, tail-label loss and gradient norm at 8 stage points, and it picks the augmentation policy, AdamW learning rate, schedule shape and loss mixture. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, seed variance.
CONTROLS: Static AdamW with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 10 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; learned controller given shuffled signals.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: The learned controller gains about 0.8 mAP beyond the rules, with lower seed variance. It could fail if thresholds tuned by hand already capture most of the signal.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Contextual choice of augmentation and loss on two benchmarks
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on NUS-WIDE for 30 epochs with 2 seeds and on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 30 epochs with 3 seeds, with a controller that sets the augmentation strength and the loss at 5 stage points from the validation mAP and the tail-label loss. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static BCE with RandAugment; static asymmetric loss with weak augmentation; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller with shuffled inputs.
COST: 20
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 1 point on both sets. It could fail if the behaviour learned on NUS-WIDE differs from VOC, making gains uneven.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Meta-learned update rule for loss weights on VOC
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 60 epochs with 5 seeds. A small network reads the per-label validation loss and the positive rate, then outputs the loss weight of a label at 6 stage points, trained by hypergradients on a held-out split. Metrics: mAP, recall of the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static BCE; class-balanced weights from label frequency; asymmetric loss; controller outputting uniform weights.
COST: 20
PREDICTION: Tail recall rises by about 2 points and mAP by 0.3. It could fail if hypergradients on a small held-out split overfit, giving unstable weights.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Interaction study of optimizer and loss with adaptive scheduling
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-101 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs with 4 seeds in a 2 by 2 design: optimizer SGD or AdamW, loss BCE or asymmetric, each static or controlled by a rule that reads validation mAP and tail-label loss at 5 stage points. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, and the interaction term in an analysis of variance.
CONTROLS: Static versions of all 4 combinations; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller with shuffled inputs.
COST: 96
PREDICTION: Control helps most for the AdamW and asymmetric pair, by about 0.8 mAP. It could fail if the interaction term is small, so component choices do not need coordination.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adaptive controller tested on one large and one small benchmark
PROPOSAL: Train ResNet-50 on MS-COCO for 40 epochs with 2 seeds and on PASCAL VOC 2007 for 40 epochs with 5 seeds. A controller reads validation mAP and tail-label loss at 5 stage points and sets the augmentation strength, learning rate multiplier and loss together. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static SGD with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 8 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; controller with shuffled inputs.
COST: 96
PREDICTION: Gains of about 0.5 mAP on COCO and 0.3 on VOC with faster convergence, reported on the test split. It could fail if gains on VOC are smaller than seed variance.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint adaptive control with a large transformer on two benchmarks
PROPOSAL: Train ViT-L/16 on MS-COCO and on a 500-label subset of Open Images for 60 epochs with 3 seeds. A policy network trained by PPO reads validation mAP, tail-label loss and label co-occurrence drift at 8 stage points and sets augmentation, optimizer, learning rate multiplier and loss together. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP.
CONTROLS: Static AdamW with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 10 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; policy given a constant state.
COST: 500
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 2 points on both sets. It could fail if the policy needs more updates than one run provides, so it ends near the baseline.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Seed-rich evaluation of a policy controller with a base transformer
PROPOSAL: Train ViT-B/16 on MS-COCO for 60 epochs with 6 seeds. A policy network trained by PPO reads validation mAP, tail-label loss and label co-occurrence drift at 8 stage points and sets augmentation, optimizer, learning rate multiplier and loss together. Metrics: mAP, mAP on the rarest 20 % of labels, epochs to reach 90 % of final mAP, tested by a paired comparison on seeds.
CONTROLS: Static AdamW with cosine decay and asymmetric loss; random search with 10 trials; staged schedule with fixed milestones; policy given a constant state; policy with a frozen random initialization.
COST: 500
PREDICTION: Tail mAP rises by about 1.5 points with a clear paired gain. It could fail if the policy needs more updates than one run provides, so it ends near the baseline.
